unparsed.prereq_text: Business Administration 1220E, or Economics 1021A/B and Economics 1022A/B.
Calculus 1501A/B or Calculus 1301A/B with a minimum mark of 85%, and Mathematics 1600A/B.
Computer Science 2210A/B and Computer Science 2214A/B, or registration in the Honours Specialization in Computer Science.
Statistical Sciences 2244A/B or Statistical Sciences 1024A/B, Economics 1021A/B and Economics 1022A/B.
At least 60% in English 1020 or 1022E, or permission of the Department.
Geography 1500F/G or registration in a Geography module.
One of Ontario Secondary School MCV4U, MHF4U, or Mathematics 1229A/B.
Psychology 2035A/B and Psychology 2810, or permission of the instructor.
Calculus 1301A/B or Calculus 1501A/B (each with a minimum mark of 60%), or permission of the Department.
Writing 1000F/G or any first-year English course.
